page.overview:
What is Felix the Shark?

Felix was a sleek, six feet long animatronic shark with shiny and smooth blue-gray rubbery skin, warm dark eyes, and an upturned mouth full of teeth. After years of being abandoned, however, his appearance begins to decay. Felix's skin becomes mottled, hanging in strips that flutter out behind the shark as he swims and reveals his corroded endoskeleton. One of his black eyes dangles from his face.

Felix was an animatronic that had its own area at its respective Freddy Fazbear's Pizza place, a small underwater swimming system where guest could put on a set of scuba gear and swim laps around the building with Felix once he was released by the pizza place's staff.

While searching for Felix, Dirk discovers that Felix is based on an experience the author of his favorite book had when at the beach with her family. The family suffered a great loss that day with their youngest child, Lonnie, drowning. Aaron then spotted a shark approaching the poor child's floating corpse. Both parents thought the shark would most likely eat the body, but instead, the shark pushed the body towards Aaron and then swam off after the father picked up the body.

Aaron built the pizza place with the castle-style moat attraction in honor of the shark. The business did well at first, but it went downhill after parents told the owners Felix had scared their kid(s) and they were suffering nightmares as well as one child almost drowning inside the moat, which caused the pizzeria to be closed down. After some time had passed, the town decided to build a water park above the abandoned pizza place which didn't last very long due to unknown reasons and was also eventually shut down.
